title: Without DOCUMENT_VIEW the Documents tab is not offered, and its link shows nothing
steps: Create role D-NODOCVIEW-MUA6YIPXC49E (no DOCUMENT_VIEW / DOCUMENT_MANAGE); sign in as d-nodocview-mua6yir58337; open the invoice, then its ?tab=documents link
expected: No Documents tab; the direct link falls back to another tab; no refused request
actual: tabs: History; documents panel after the deep link: not shown; failed requests: []

title: A document uploaded from the tab appears in the record's History tab
steps: Payment 1 > Documents > upload d-history-check.pdf; open the History tab
expected: The upload is in the record's history, naming the document
actual: History shows: 3 Documents | Document Uploaded 21 Sep 2026, 12:41 AM • by admin | Document Uploaded 21 Sep 2026, 12:39 AM • by admin | Document Uploaded 21 Sep 2026, 12:15 AM • by admin (the entry records the action, the time and the actor; it does not name the file)
